<script>
(function() {
    const secondaryMenu = document.querySelector('#secondaryMenuOriginal .desktop-secondary-ul');
    const mobileContainer = document.querySelector('.mobile-only-categories');
    
    if (secondaryMenu && mobileContainer) {
        mobileContainer.appendChild(secondaryMenu.cloneNode(true));
    }

    function initMobileAccordion() {
        const primaryMenuItems = document.querySelectorAll('.main-menu > .nav-list > .menu-item-has-children');
        
        primaryMenuItems.forEach(item => {
            const link = item.querySelector('a');
            const subMenu = item.querySelector('.sub-menu');
            
            if (link && subMenu) {
                const newLink = link.cloneNode(true);
                link.parentNode.replaceChild(newLink, link);
                
                newLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    item.classList.toggle('active');
                    subMenu.classList.toggle('active');
                });
            }
        });

        setTimeout(function() {
            const secondaryMenuItems = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-only-categories .menu-item-has-children');
            
            secondaryMenuItems.forEach(item => {
                const link = item.querySelector('a');
                const subMenu = item.querySelector('.sub-menu');
                
                if (link && subMenu) {
                    const newLink = link.cloneNode(true);
                    link.parentNode.replaceChild(newLink, link);
                    
                    newLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        item.classList.toggle('active');
                        subMenu.classList.toggle('active');
                    });
                }
            });
        }, 100);
    }

    if (window.innerWidth <= 1040) {
        initMobileAccordion();
    }

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            if (window.innerWidth <= 1040) {
                initMobileAccordion();
            }
        }, 250);
    });
})();

function toggleMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('mobileMenuOverlay');
    if (!menu) return;
    
    menu.classList.toggle('active');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.toggle('active');
    
    document.body.classList.toggle('menu-active');
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
        if (menu && menu.classList.contains('active')) {
            toggleMenu();
        }
    }
});

(function() {
    const toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.dark-mode-toggle');
    if (!toggles.length) return;

    const isDark = localStorage.getItem('sdn-dark-mode') === 'true';
    if (isDark) {
        document.body.classList.add('dark-mode');
    }

    document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark-mode-preload');

    toggles.forEach(function(toggle) {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.body.classList.toggle('dark-mode');
            const nowDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode');
            localStorage.setItem('sdn-dark-mode', nowDark);
        });
    });
})();

(function() {
    if (!window.SDN_LazyLoader) return;
    
    var loader = window.SDN_LazyLoader;
    loader.loadedCount = 0;
    loader.triggered = false;
    loader.initialized = false;

    loader.loadNext = function() {
        if (this.loadedCount >= this.scripts.length) {
            document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sdn:lazy-scripts-loaded'));
            return;
        }
        var item = this.scripts[this.loadedCount];
        var script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = item.url;
        script.async = true;
        script.onload = () => {
            if (item.callback) item.callback();
            this.loadedCount++;
            this.loadNext();
        };
        document.body.appendChild(script);
    };

    loader.init = function() {
        if (this.initialized) return;
        this.initialized = true;

        var trigger = () => {
            if (this.triggered) return;
            if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                this.triggered = true;
                this.loadNext();
                window.removeEventListener('scroll', trigger);
            }
        };

        if (window.scrollY > 0) {
            this.triggered = true;
            this.loadNext();
        } else {
            window.addEventListener('scroll', trigger, { passive: true });
        }
    };

    loader.init();
})();

        triggers.forEach(function(trigger) {
            if (trigger.dataset.aiInit) return;
            trigger.dataset.aiInit = 'true';

            trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();

                var existingMenu = document.getElementById('ai-dynamic-dropdown');
                if (existingMenu) { closeMenu(existingMenu); return; }

                var article = trigger.closest('.article');
                var postUrl = article
                    ? 'https://shiftdelete.net/' + article.getAttribute('data-post-url')
                    : window.location.href;
                var pageTitle = article
                    ? article.querySelector('h1').innerText
                    : document.title;

                var finalPrompt = encodeURIComponent(
                    "Yalnızca ShiftDelete.net sitesinin " + postUrl + " adresindeki içeriği referans alarak " + pageTitle + " başlıklı içerik için özet oluştur."
                );

                var aiServices = [
                    { name: 'ChatGPT',    svg: '<svg class="sdn-icon"><use xlink:href="/wp-content/themes/shiftdelete/assets/icons.svg?v=1.1.4#icon-chatgpt"></use></svg>',    url: 'https://chat.openai.com/?q=' + finalPrompt },
                    { name: 'Claude',     svg: '<svg class="sdn-icon"><use xlink:href="/wp-content/themes/shiftdelete/assets/icons.svg?v=1.1.4#icon-claude"></use></svg>',     url: 'https://claude.ai/new?q=' + finalPrompt },
                    { name: 'Grok',       svg: '<svg class="sdn-icon"><use xlink:href="/wp-content/themes/shiftdelete/assets/icons.svg?v=1.1.4#icon-grok"></use></svg>',       url: 'https://x.com/i/grok?text=' + finalPrompt },
                    { name: 'Perplexity', svg: '<svg class="sdn-icon"><use xlink:href="/wp-content/themes/shiftdelete/assets/icons.svg?v=1.1.4#icon-perplexity"></use></svg>', url: 'https://www.perplexity.ai/search/new?q=' + finalPrompt }
                ];

                var menu = document.createElement('div');
                menu.id = 'ai-dynamic-dropdown';
                menu.innerHTML = aiServices.map(function(ai) {
                    return '<div class="ai-dropdown-item" onclick="window.open(\'' + ai.url + '\', \'_blank\')">' +
                               '<div class="ai-icon-wrapper">' + ai.svg + '</div>' +
                               '<span class="ai-name">' + ai.name + '</span>' +
                           '</div>';
                }).join('');

                trigger.parentElement.appendChild(menu);
                setTimeout(function() { menu.classList.add('show'); }, 10);

                var outsideClick = function(event) {
                    if (!menu.contains(event.target) && event.target !== trigger) {
                        closeMenu(menu);
                        document.removeEventListener('click', outsideClick);
                    }
                };
                document.addEventListener('click', outsideClick);
            });
        });
    }

    function closeMenu(menu) {
        menu.classList.remove('show');
        setTimeout(function() { menu.remove(); }, 200);
    }
	
	window.initAiSummarize = initAiSummarize;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        initAiSummarize(document);
    });

})();
</script>
